marketRegime: Choppy, low-conviction 5-minute crypto regime: most recent entries show small/moderate price moves (6-27 bps) with mixed peer agreement (0/1 to 4/0) and asks clustered in the 0.5-0.65 'crowded' range where edges are thin (0.02-0.10) after costs. The lesson-veto log shows the system now encountering move10-20 and left60-120 conditions very frequently in live flow, indicating the current market is producing exactly the marginal, high-frequency, low-magnitude moves that historically lose money. BTC is showing a 'hot' flag with spot ~$86,071 and best_sum 1.01 (near-arbitrage mispricing), suggesting intermittent cross-market arb opportunities are available but underexploited given only 13 ARB trades historically.

applied.reason: move10-20 bucket is validated-negative (-33.47 pnl, 28/81 win, expectancy -0.41) and still appears near-constantly in live SKIP logs; move20+ bucket is solidly profitable (+10.14 pnl, 56% win). Raising the floor from 20 to 25 pushes entries further into the proven-profitable move20+ zone and reduces marginal trades sitting right at the vetoed boundary.

left60-120 bucket is validated-negative (-20.25 pnl, 21/59 win) and left<60 is catastrophic (-19.40 pnl, 2/13 win) while left120+ is the only time-bucket that's net positive (+10.77 pnl, 175 trades). Current param already requires >=150s but live log shows many entries at 122-149s left, i.e. right at the boundary of the losing left60-120 bucket. Tightening to a firm 120s floor paired with existing veto logic reduces bleed from marginal-time entries.

Numerous live entries execute at $21-55 liquidity, well under the stated 80 floor, suggesting either inconsistent enforcement or the floor is too low relative to what's needed to avoid slippage-driven stop-loss blowouts (several stops realized at 0.19-0.25 vs stop_loss_bid=0.32). Raising the floor should reduce thin-book executions that are correlated with the worst stop realizations.

Recent EXIT logs show stop losses realized at 0.19-0.25 bid, far below the configured 0.32 trigger, implying slippage/confirm-tick delay lets losses run well past intended risk. Raising the stop threshold to 0.40 should trigger exits earlier and cap downside closer to the stop_frac_of_entry=0.45 target.

ARB setup is strongly profitable (92% win, +$5.89/13 trades) but rare; allowing 2 concurrent positions lets the bot hold a momentum trade and still capture an ARB/ARB_LEG opportunity (hot:true, best_sum:1.01 observed in diagnostics) without having to skip one for the other.

diagnosis: The bot is roughly break-even overall (50.7% win rate, -$68.37 over 404 trades) with the loss concentrated almost entirely in the MOMENTUM setup (-$55.81 over 383 trades, 49% win) and in a handful of bad-move-magnitude and low-time-left trades. ARB is a clear small edge (92% win, +$5.89) but too rare (13 trades) to matter. The 'move10-20' bucket (-33.47 pnl, 28/81 win, expectancy -0.41) and 'left60-120' bucket (-20.25 pnl, 21/59 win) are now vetoed and are visibly firing correctly in the recent decision log (many SKIP ... LESSON_VETO: move10-20). However the bot is still entering trades with move just above 20bps or with weak peer agreement that produce low edges (edge ~0.02-0.04) and high stop-loss realization (several EXIT ... stop loss @ 0.19-0.25, i.e. losing ~70-80% of stake) which suggests stops are too loose/late relative to how fast these 5m markets move, and position sizing on marginal-edge trades is not being cut. Coin-level data shows doge (-23.45, 39% win) and xrp (-12.50, 49% win) are structurally weak, while btc (+10.83, 60% win) is the bot's best performer. The 'all-agree' bucket is paradoxically a net loser (-18.99 pnl, 50/112 win) despite intuitively being the most confident signal, and 'alone' trades are also negative -- both already flagged for reduce_confidence but action has not been hardened into a parameter (e.g., tighter momentum_min_confidence or size reduction isn't reflected in current params). Live diagnostics show thin liquidity (many trades liq $25-55, near the $80 min_liquidity_usd floor being bypassed or the floor too low) and tight time-left entries (130-150s), consistent with the left<60/left60-120 losing buckets. Net effect: the lesson-veto system is doing real work (blocking move10-20 and left60-120 repeatedly in the live log) but the underlying parameter set (momentum_min_move_bps=20, min_entry_left_sec=150, stop_loss_bid=0.32) has not been tightened to reflect what the data already proves, so the bot keeps grazing the edge of vetoed zones and absorbing hard stop-losses.
priorityActions: Tighten momentum_min_move_bps from 20 to 25 to shift entries fully into the validated-profitable move20+ zone and away from the loss-making move10-20 boundary that's still triggering vetoes constantly in live flow.
Raise stop_loss_bid from 0.32 to 0.40 to address the pattern of stops realizing at 0.19-0.25 bid, which indicates far worse-than-intended downside capture on losing trades.
Implement an explicit size/confidence reduction for the 'all-agree' and 'alone' buckets (both net negative) rather than leaving action=reduce_confidence unimplemented in the live parameter set.
Increase min_liquidity_usd from 80 to 100 to filter out the thinnest-book entries ($21-55 liquidity) correlated with worse stop execution.

Expand ARB/ARB_LEG trade frequency (currently only 13+8 trades combined) given its 92% win rate and the 'hot'/best_sum:1.01 flag currently showing in diagnostics \u2014 this is the bot's highest-confidence, most underexploited edge.
Add asset-specific tracking/throttling for DOGE given its standalone -23.45 pnl and 39% win rate, the worst of all five coins by a wide margin.
